columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Geant4 event id + event_id_offset; unique within the run

columns.name: n_pethits
columns.description: Number of pethits rows of this event

columns.name: source_x_mm
columns.description: Sampled source position, world frame (x)

columns.name: source_y_mm
columns.description: Sampled source position, world frame (y)

columns.name: source_z_mm
columns.description: Sampled source position, world frame (z)

columns.name: annih_x_mm
columns.description: Positron annihilation vertex, world frame; NULL when the event has none (x)

columns.name: annih_y_mm
columns.description: Positron annihilation vertex, world frame; NULL when the event has none (y)

columns.name: annih_z_mm
columns.description: Positron annihilation vertex, world frame; NULL when the event has none (z)

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Owning event (references events.event_id)

columns.name: hit_ordinal
columns.description: PROPOSED: position of the hit within its event in g4ring's flush order; not written today

columns.name: hit_type
columns.description: 0 prompt, 1 annihilation photon 1, 2 annihilation photon 2, 4 pre

columns.name: crystal_id
columns.description: GDML copy number of the crystal (references the crystal map)

columns.name: edep_keV
columns.description: Aggregated energy deposit in the crystal

columns.name: time_ps
columns.description: Time of the earliest deposit since the event start

columns.name: nHits
columns.description: Geant4 steps aggregated into this hit

columns.name: n_compton
columns.description: Compton scatters before the hit (saturates at 255); NULL when not recorded

columns.name: n_rayleigh
columns.description: Rayleigh scatters before the hit (saturates at 255); NULL when not recorded

columns.name: pos_x_mm
columns.description: Energy-weighted deposit centroid (x)

columns.name: pos_y_mm
columns.description: Energy-weighted deposit centroid (y)

columns.name: pos_z_mm
columns.description: Energy-weighted deposit centroid (z)

columns.name: first_x_mm
columns.description: Position of the earliest deposit (x)

columns.name: first_y_mm
columns.description: Position of the earliest deposit (y)

columns.description: Position of the earliest deposit (z)
